newsitem.title: MEXICO: RESEARCH ALERT-Gigante rated moderate outperform.
newsitem.headline: RESEARCH ALERT-Gigante rated moderate outperform.

text.p: Lazard Freres & Co said on Friday it began coverage of Mexican retailer Grupo Gigante with a moderate outperform rating.

-- "Considering Gigante's relatively low risk current valuation and the potential for a significant improvement in the company's outlook, we are initiating coverage of the stock with a 'Moderate Outperform' rating," analysts Curtis Butler and Kristina Salen wrote in a report.
-- The analysts said Mexico's third largest retailer should see sales should grow 3.3 percent in real terms in 1997 and 10.7 percent in 1998.
-- They forecast an improvement in the company's operating margin to 2.7 percent in 1997 and 3.0 percent in 1998, up from 2.4 percent in 1996.

-- "Gigante management appears to be contemplating an end to its joint venture with Carrefour, and we are beginning to view such a separation as likely," the analysts wrote. They said the three-year-old $140 million investment has seen "arguably little or no return on the investment."
-- Gigante shares in Mexico were unchanged in morning trade at 2.63 pesos.
